content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Little Rock

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—secondary degree holders and bachelor's degree holders face different thresholds. Granite PM Academy's advisors can verify your qualifications before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Attend Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our instructors cover the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world scenarios relevant to Little Rock's construction, healthcare, and government sectors. Completion earns your required contact hours and positions you for exam success.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and submit your PMP application, documenting your education and project experience. Pay the associated exam fee directly to PMI. Our team provides guidance on application requirements and deadlines to keep your certification timeline on track.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to build confidence. Schedule your exam at an authorized Pearson VUE testing center in Arkansas. Our support continues through your exam day to maximize your readiness.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP®, commit to the three-year renewal cycle by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through approved training, certifications, and project-management activities. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible programs to keep your credential active and your skills current.
